title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. translated_title: Agent Zero Memory：面向大语言模型智能体的溯源感知长期记忆系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体需要对用户或组织所说和存储的一切内容拥有持久、忠实的记忆，然而大多数记忆系统都采用单一的组织结构（事实库、向量索引或知识图谱），并因此继承了其固有盲点。我们提出了 Agent Zero Memory，这是一个溯源感知的长期记忆系统，它将用户的对话、文件和连接的数据源提炼为三个并行的记忆系统，每个系统捕捉同一历史的不同侧面：情景式的记忆事件时间线，将“何时发生了什么变化”作为一等公民进行管理；关联式的实体-事件知识图谱，跨会话地连接人物和项目；以及语义化的、经过策展的、引用锁定的持久事实分层文档记忆（HDM）。检索轮次会运行一个意图门控（因此自包含的轮次不会增加额外延迟）、一个来源路由器，以及三个并发的智能体搜索（每个记忆系统各一个），每个搜索都是一个基于混合……
tldr: 该论文提出了溯源感知的长期记忆系统 Agent Zero Memory，通过并行的事件时间线、实体-事件知识图谱和引用锁定的分层文档记忆三种结构，从多侧面为 LLM 智能体构建持久而忠实的记忆。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distills user conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory structures—an episodic event timeline, an entity-event knowledge graph, and a citation-locked hierarchical documentary memory—to provide LLM agents with durable and faithful memory.
